strings.story.spring_fair_intro.1: Maplebrook wakes up to the first warm morning of spring.
strings.story.spring_fair_intro.2: Wren! Wren! The wind blew through the post office and every label for the Spring Fair got jumbled!
strings.story.spring_fair_intro.3: Jumbled labels? Then let's sort them. Every word belongs with one category card.
strings.story.spring_fair_intro.4: Open a category in an empty slot first, dear. The words will follow.
strings.story.spring_fair_outro.1: Every stall is labelled and the pies are cooling. The Spring Fair is ready!
strings.story.spring_fair_outro.2: Most fun I've had since I built the bandstand. And that was a real plank-buster.
strings.story.spring_fair_outro.3: Oh no. I think I left the harvest crates down by the river…
strings.story.harvest_market_intro.1: Summer slips by, and the orchards turn gold.
strings.story.harvest_market_intro.2: The harvest crates! The river mixed them all up and the market opens tomorrow!
strings.story.harvest_market_intro.3: Same trick as spring, just bigger piles. Watch the slots: there are fewer slots than categories.
strings.story.harvest_market_outro.1: Look at that. The whole market is sorted. Maplebrook hasn't looked this cheerful in years.
strings.story.harvest_market_outro.2: Next up, the winter lantern walk. I'd better start building lanterns.
strings.tutorial.l1.start: Tap a category card, then tap an empty slot to open that category.
strings.tutorial.l1.category: Now tap a word that belongs to it, then tap the category to sort it.
strings.tutorial.l2.start: Need more cards? Tap the deck to draw. Every move counts!
strings.tutorial.mismatch: Wrong group costs a move. Take a second look before you tap.
